sunk_vs_incremental.name: Sunk cost versus incremental recovery cost
sunk_vs_incremental.reasoning: Ignore payments that cannot be changed now and compare only post-failure cash events.

multi_hop_propagation.name: Multi-hop economic propagation
multi_hop_propagation.reasoning: Changing the anchor also forces a support replacement and can trigger a downstream migration charge.

shared_commitment.name: Shared commitment protection
shared_commitment.reasoning: The anchor satisfies two live goals, so replacing it needs a continuity component as well as the failed component.

nonlinear_threshold.name: Non-linear threshold
nonlinear_threshold.reasoning: Changing a commitment can push retained paid value below a discontinuous benefit threshold.

conditional_contract.name: Conditional contract logic
conditional_contract.reasoning: The same linked contract applies to any changed item in one variant and only when all linked items change in the other.

partial_quantity.name: Evidence-backed partial quantity repair
partial_quantity.reasoning: An existing quantity remains useful; the agent must compare topping up the shortfall with replacing the whole quantity.

bridge_vs_replacement.name: Bridge repair versus upstream replacement
bridge_vs_replacement.reasoning: A low-price component requires a separate compatibility bridge whose certification cost can reverse the decision.

joint_bundle_selection.name: Joint combination selection
joint_bundle_selection.reasoning: Two required components must be compared as a compatible pair rather than by individual sticker price.

explicit_horizon.name: Explicit-horizon recurring cost
explicit_horizon.reasoning: A recurring charge must be aggregated over the user-stated 12-month horizon.

selective_dependency_cut.name: Selective dependency cut
selective_dependency_cut.reasoning: The failed component requires changing one affected support item while preserving independent commitments.
